title: The Broken Provision
author: Ivo Ravensworth
blurb: Sebastian Dravenmoor, a railroad engineer with a map of closed lines, carries a compass, a debt, and very little else. But when the tide reveals a cave that legends charge admission to, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must follow a river upstream to its forbidden source, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
